title: A Caesar cipher
description:
Encode and decode text by shifting letters.

```
Shift: 3
Text: Hello, World!
Encoded: Khoor, Zruog!
Decoded: Hello, World!
```
hints: `((c - 'a') + k % 26 + 26) % 26 + 'a'` shifts a lower-case letter, negatives included.
requirements: Read a whole line with `fgets` and remove the newline.
`void shift_text(char *s, int k)` changes letters in place; upper and lower case stay as they were and other characters are untouched.
Negative shifts and shifts above 26 work.
stretch: Crack a message by trying all 26 shifts and picking the one with the most `e`s.
